text:
docs-bot: docs-scan v2 found a small cluster of URLs that include a trailing semicolon in the query/path (example below). flagged as 'dangling anchor/redirect oddity' — full CSV: https://internal-reports.company/scans/1742468001.csv

matt: who owns the runtime guide pages? i don't see a codeowners entry for that path. pinging docs folks.

julia: i edited runtime guide last quarter but not an owner. i can take a quick look — what is the impact? user-facing 404?

sam: repro steps: `curl -I \"https://redwood.dev/runtime/guide/?section=deploy;\"` -> 302 to `/runtime/guide/` then 404 in our staging edge in eu-west. seems CDN/nginx treats trailing `;` oddly. not all regions fail, but scan shows ~12 affected urls. gist with sample list: https://gist.github.com/sam-gist/abcd1234

olivia: @matt can we get a quick owner/claim so this doesn't linger. options: (1) update docs to remove semicolon in canonical links / shortlinks, (2) server-side rewrite to strip trailing semicolons, or (3) short redirect rule in CDN. prefer docs-first if trivial. :thinking_face:

matt: ok — julia, would you claim and open a tiny PR to either fix the links or add an explanatory redirect? if it's more infra-y, tag eng-infra/ops. mark as docs-scan / priority p2.

julia: i can claim. quick ask: bot csv link 403 for me — can someone paste the samples in-thread? also, do we have a canonicalize script we can run to catch similar patterns?

sam: pasted the gist above with ~12 urls and suggested nginx snippet i tested on staging container (local):

```
# strip trailing semicolon in request uri
if ($request_uri ~ ";$") {
  return 301 $scheme://$host$uri;
}
```
Tested locally, fixed the redirect loop. if we go server-side we should add to ops-runbook and have canary in staging first.

olivia: :thumbsup: prefer docs edits where safe. server change is ok fallback but ops should review. julia — when you open the PR, add a short QA checklist: preview in staging eu-west and us-west, and confirm links render without `;`. also reference the gist.

matt: sounds good. tagging `docs/sprint` and `eng-infra` for visibility. Julia — can you drop the PR link here when ready?

julia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 — fixes the 12URLs in the guide, adds a tiny redirect note to ops-runbook, and includes the staging QA steps. assigned @matt for review.

sam: quick review notes left on PR — suggest moving the nginx snippet into ops-runbook rather than live site config.

matt: i'll take a look now. thanks everyone for the quick handoff.
